name: C4-3 Pre-norm Transformer block, assembled
description: Six nodes, one shape: (1, 5, 8) in and (1, 5, 8) out

params.label: Block output — same shape (1, 5, 8) as the input

data.noteContent:
The block every decoder stacks, built out of parts you can open. Normalise, attend, add the input back; normalise again, run the feed-forward, add again. Pre-norm means each LayerNorm sits before its sub-layer rather than after, which is what lets deep stacks train without warmup tricks.

The two Adds matter more than they look. Without them a gradient would have to travel through every sub-layer in turn, and a stack of eighty blocks would not train at all.

Every port in the chain carries (1, 5, 8): a block improves token features in place, so stacking N introduces no new shapes. Read the note on the attention node before trusting its weights.

每個 decoder 都在堆疊的區塊，用可以打開來看的零件組起來。正規化、做注意力、把輸入加回去；再正規化一次、跑前饋網路、再加一次。pre-norm 的意思是每個 LayerNorm 放在子層之前而不是之後，深層堆疊才能不靠 warmup 技巧就訓練起來。

那兩顆 Add 比看起來重要。沒有它們，梯度就得一層一層穿過每個子層，堆八十層根本訓練不動。

這條鏈上每個輸出埠都是 (1, 5, 8)：一個區塊是就地改善 token 的特徵，所以堆 N 個也不會生出新的形狀。在相信注意力權重之前，先看那顆節點上的說明。

These Edu nodes read dimension 0 as the sequence and dimension 1 as the batch. This input is (1, 5, 8), so they see one token in a batch of five: the weights come back (5, 2, 1, 1), every value 1.0, because a lone token can only attend to itself. Squeeze dim 0 first, as C6-2 does, for a real 5x5 matrix.

這些 Edu 節點把第 0 維當序列、第 1 維當 batch。這裡輸入是 (1, 5, 8)，所以它看到的是 batch 五筆、每筆一個 token：權重出來是 (5, 2, 1, 1)，每個值都是 1.0，因為單獨一個 token 只能注意自己。像 C6-2 那樣先 Squeeze 掉第 0 維，才會得到真正的 5x5 矩陣。

The residual. tensor_a is what attention produced, tensor_b is the block's untouched input, and alpha is left at its default 1.0, so this is a plain sum. Wire mha.output into ln2 and add2 instead and the graph still runs; it just stops being trainable once the stack gets deep.

這是殘差。tensor_a 是注意力算出來的東西，tensor_b 是這個區塊原封不動的輸入，alpha 保持預設的 1.0，所以就是單純相加。改成把 mha.output 接到 ln2 和 add2，圖還是跑得動，只是堆深了就訓練不起來。
